verifications.claim: Prime Video has officially renewed the series Cross for a third season
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Prime Video said Wednesday that it has renewed the hit thriller series Cross for an eight-episode third season." (R2); "Prime Video announced Wednesday that it has renewed Cross for a third season." (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Prime Video renewed Cross for season 3.

verifications.claim: The renewal of Cross was announced on March 18, 2026
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "March 18, 2026 / 3:17 PM" (R3); "On March 18, Prime Video announced the renewal" (R4, R6); "Published Mar 18, 2026" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Several sources explicitly state the announcement date as March 18, 2026.

verifications.claim: The announcement was made alongside the Season 2 finale
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Season 2, which drops its season finale today" (R2); "The Season 2 finale premiered today" (R3); "Following the just-released season 2 finale" (R5); "Just hours after Prime Video dropped the season 2 finale" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm announcement on the same day as Season 2 finale release, directly supporting 'alongside'.

verifications.claim: Aldis Hodge stars as Alex Cross in Cross
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Cross stars Aldis Hodge as the brilliant and complex detective Alex Cross" (R2); "Aldis Hodge plays James Patterson's detective, Alex Cross" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources directly confirm Aldis Hodge stars as Alex Cross.

verifications.claim: Cross will return for eight new episodes
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "renewed ... Cross for an eight-episode third season" (R2); "The eight-episode Season 3" (R4, R6); "renewed Cross for season 3, which will consist of eight episodes" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state season 3 has eight episodes.

verifications.claim: Cross continues the adaptation of James Patterson’s detective novels
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Created by Ben Watkins based on James Patterson’s bestselling novels" (R2); "based on bestselling author James Patterson's Alex Cross series" (R5); "based on the long-running novels by superstar author James Patterson" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm the series is based on/continues adaptation of Patterson's novels/series.
